headline.en: Barcelona play Feyenoord at home at 18:45 on 9 September
headline.es: El Barca juega contra el Feyenoord en casa a las 18:45 del 9 de septiembre

summary.en: UEFA published the league-phase kickoff times on Saturday. Barcelona host Feyenoord at Camp Nou on 9 September at 18:45 CET. That is the first of eight league-phase games. Next come Galatasaray away, Paris Saint-Germain away, Aston Villa at home, Sabah away, Manchester City at home, Sporting away and Como at home.
summary.es: La UEFA publico el sabado los horarios. El Barca recibe al Feyenoord el 9 de septiembre a las 18:45. Luego Galatasaray, PSG, Villa, Sabah, City, Sporting y Como.

body.en: UEFA set the times on Saturday. Barcelona's first league-phase match is Feyenoord at Camp Nou on Wednesday 9 September at 18:45. The early kickoff comes after a Liga weekend, so recovery time is short. The rest of the list is now public too. Barcelona go to Galatasaray and then to Paris in consecutive away weeks in October. Aston Villa visit in November. Manchester City visit in December. Sporting and Como complete the eight games. SPORT said the October and December block is the hard part of the group, not the opening night. Eric Garcia is already banned for Feyenoord because of a red card from last season. Flick asked for a bigger squad in August because these midweeks come close together. The next Liga match is Rayo on Monday. That game does not change the European list. It only decides who is fresh nine days later.

headline.en: Eric Garcia is banned for the Feyenoord match
headline.es: Eric Garcia esta sancionado para el partido contra el Feyenoord

summary.en: Eric Garcia will miss Barcelona's first Champions League match. He was sent off last season in the quarter-final second leg at Atletico Madrid. UEFA carry that red card into the next European game. Jules Kounde and Xavi Espart can play on that side on 9 September.
summary.es: Eric Garcia se pierde el primer partido de Champions. Lo expulsaron la temporada pasada en el Metropolitano. Kounde y Espart pueden cubrir esa banda el 9 de septiembre.

body.en: Eric Garcia is banned for Feyenoord on 9 September. He was sent off in last season's Champions League quarter-final second leg at Atletico Madrid. UEFA rule 63.01 moves a straight red to the player's next European match. Barcelona went out of that tie, so Garcia never served the ban until now. There is no new red card this season. Sergi Sole reported the ban in Mundo Deportivo on Saturday, after UEFA published the kickoff times. Jules Kounde can play on that side if he is fit. Xavi Espart can also cover it. Flick already used Espart at left-back in Elche. Using him on the right in Europe is possible, but it is cover, not his main role. The ban only lasts one European night. It becomes harder if Kounde also misses Liga minutes in the days around that match. Until then, Garcia is out of Feyenoord and available for Liga.

headline.en: Livakovic trained with the first team. He is not listed yet
headline.es: Livakovic entrenó con el primer equipo. Aun no esta inscrito

summary.en: Dominik Livakovic signed until 2030. Barcelona paid a low fixed fee and add-ons to Fenerbahce. He trained with the first team on Saturday. Joan Garcia is still first choice. Whether Livakovic is registered for Liga and Europe, or goes on loan, depends on fair play.
summary.es: Livakovic firmo hasta 2030. El sabado trabajo con el primer equipo. Joan Garcia sigue de titular. La ficha depende del fair play.

body.en: Livakovic signed a contract until 2030. The fee to Fenerbahce is low, with add-ons. He trained with Barcelona's first team on Saturday. That means he is at the club. It does not mean he is on the Liga list. Joan Garcia has started both Liga games and kept two clean sheets. Szczesny is still there as backup. Ter Stegen is on loan at Ajax. Barcelona already have to register Gordon, Adeyemi, Rodri and Cancelo under the 1:1 rule. A fourth goalkeeper only helps if his name can go on the squad list. If the ratio is tight, Livakovic may be loaned. Mundo Deportivo and MARCA both reported him in Saturday's session. Until LaLiga publishes the registration, the contract is signed and the role is open. Joan Garcia remains the starter for Rayo on Monday.
